entries.title: Job 12:1
segments: ¶And Job answered and said,

entries.title: Job 12:2
segments: Truly ye are the people, and wisdom shall die with you!

entries.title: Job 12:3
segments: I also have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you; and who knoweth not such things as these?

entries.title: Job 12:4
segments: I am to be one that is a derision to his friend, I who call upon +God, and whom he will answer: a derision is the just upright [man].

entries.title: Job 12:5
segments: He that is ready to stumble with the foot is a lamp despised in the thought of him that is at ease.

entries.title: Job 12:6
segments: ¶The tents of desolators are in peace, and they that provoke *God are secure; into whose hand +God bringeth.

entries.title: Job 12:7
segments: But ask now the beasts, and they shall teach thee; and the fowl of the heavens, and they shall tell thee;

entries.title: Job 12:8
segments: Or speak to the earth, and it shall teach thee; and the fishes of the sea shall declare unto thee.

entries.title: Job 12:9
segments: Who knoweth not in all these, that the hand of Jehovah hath wrought this?

entries.title: Job 12:10
segments: In whose hand is the soul of every living thing, and the spirit of all flesh of man.

entries.title: Job 12:11
segments: Doth not the ear try words, as the palate tasteth food?

entries.title: Job 12:12
segments: ¶With the aged is wisdom, and in length of days understanding.

entries.title: Job 12:13
segments: With him is wisdom and might; he hath counsel and understanding.

entries.title: Job 12:14
segments: Behold, he breaketh down, and it is not built again; he shutteth up a man, and there is no opening.

entries.title: Job 12:15
segments: Behold, he withholdeth the waters, and they dry up; and he sendeth them out, and they overturn the earth.

entries.title: Job 12:16
segments: With him is strength and effectual knowledge; the deceived and the deceiver are his.

entries.title: Job 12:17
segments: He leadeth counsellors away spoiled, and judges maketh he fools;

entries.title: Job 12:18
segments: He weakeneth the government of kings, and bindeth their loins with a fetter;

entries.title: Job 12:19
segments: He leadeth priests away spoiled, and overthroweth the mighty;

entries.title: Job 12:20
segments: He depriveth of speech the trusty, and taketh away the judgment of the elders;

entries.title: Job 12:21
segments: He poureth contempt upon nobles, and slackeneth the girdle of the mighty;

entries.title: Job 12:22
segments: He discovereth deep things out of darkness, and bringeth out into light the shadow of death;

entries.title: Job 12:23
segments: He increaseth the nations, and destroyeth them; he spreadeth out the nations, and bringeth them in;

entries.title: Job 12:24
segments: He taketh away the understanding of the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causeth them to wander in a pathless waste.

entries.title: Job 12:25
segments: They grope in the dark without light, and he maketh them to stagger like a drunkard.
